title: Expectation of the empty Walsh character
statement:
For every $n \in \bbn$, the Walsh character $\chi_\emptyset$ associated to the empty subset of $[n]$ has uniform expectation equal to one:
\[
  \E[\chi_\emptyset] \;=\; \frac{1}{2^n}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} \chi_\emptyset(x) \;=\; 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: n is a natural number (arbitrary, including n = 0)
